text: 水利部规划计划司司长李明30日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，现在距离年底还有3个月时间，水利部将进一步加大工作力度，确保实现全年新开工重大水利工程40项、完成水利建设投资1万亿元的目标。（上证报）
text_en: Li Ming, director of the Planning and Program Department of the Ministry of Water Resources, said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 30th that there are still 3 months left before the end of the year. The Ministry of Water Resources will further intensify its work to ensure the achievement of the goals of starting construction on 40 major water conservancy projects for the year and completing 1 trillion yuan in water conservancy construction investment. (Shanghai Securities News)
